question: ASIAD is regulated by ______.
solution:
The correct answer is Olympic Council of Asia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Asiad is regulated by Olympic Council of Asia.
 
• The Asian Games are also known as Asiad.
 
• Asiad is a continental multisport athletic event held every four years.
 
• The first Asian Games were organized in New Delhi, India in 1951.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The Olympic Council of Asia general assembly has selected the two countries to host the 2030 and 2034 editions of the Asian Games through virtual voting.
 
 
• Qatar will be the host of 2030's edition at Doha city, while the runner-up in voting and Saudi Arabia will host the 2034 edition of Asian Games at Riyadh city.
 
• The Olympic Council of Asia meeting held in Muscat, Oman.
 
 

 
• The International Olympic Committee (IOC) was founded by Baron Pierre de Coubertin in 1894.
 
 
• The first Olympic Games were held in Athens, Greece in the year 1896.
 
• The Olympic Games are governed by the International Olympic Committee.
 
• The Olympic Games consist of five rings colored blue, yellow, black, red, and green.
 
 
 
• Commonwealth Games Federation (CGF) nominated the inclusion of women's cricket in the 2022 Commonwealth Games in Birmingham.
 
 
• The inclusion of women's cricket in the Birmingham 2022 Commonwealth Games would be a landmark moment in the development of the sport.
 
• This is a part of the global ambition for cricket to inspire and empower women and girls around the world.
 
 
 
• The Indian Olympic Association of India (IOA) has appointed Harjinder Singh as the Chef de Mission of the country’s contingent for the upcoming 2022 Winter Olympics in Beijing.
 
 
• He is the General Secretary of Ice Hockey Association of India.
